subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Reena decided not to go to work today because she was __feeling sick.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"under the weather"** means** feeling ill or sick**. (बीमार महसूस करना)

 
 
• **Example:** I'm feeling a bit **under the weather** today, so I might not come to the party.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: ***'under the weather'.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Fit as a fiddle** (बहुत अच्छी हालत में होना): Being in very good health or condition.

 
 
• **Example:** Despite his age, he is as fit as a fiddle and runs every morning.
 
 
 
• **Sitting on the fence** (दुविधा में होना): Being undecided or not making a decision.
 
 
• **Example:** She is sitting on the fence about whether to take the job offer or not.
 
 
 
• **Going down in flames** (बुरी तरह असफल होना): To fail spectacularly.
 
 
• **Example:** The project went down in flames due to poor management.

The correct answer is: **Option 3)**
